title: email.rs core: Email/get,changes,query,queryChanges,set
description:
Implement the 5 core Email/* handlers in src/email.rs.

## Methods to implement

### Email/get (RFC 8621 §5.1)
- Fetch emails by id; honor 'properties' whitelist
- bodyProperties sub-selection (nested EmailBodyPart properties)
- fetchTextBodyValues / fetchHTMLBodyValues / fetchAllBodyValues flags
- maxBodyValueBytes truncation

### Email/changes (RFC 8621 §5.2)
- Return created/updated/destroyed email ids since sinceState
- updatedProperties optimization: if only flags/mailboxIds changed, return 'updatedProperties' list

### Email/query (RFC 8621 §5.3)
- FilterCondition: inMailbox, inMailboxOtherThan, before, after, minSize, maxSize, allInThreadHaveKeyword, someInThreadHaveKeyword, noneInThreadHaveKeyword, hasKeyword, notKeyword, hasAttachment, text, from, to, cc, bcc, subject, body, header
- SortComparator: receivedAt, from, to, subject, size, sentAt, hasKeyword, allInThreadHaveKeyword, someInThreadHaveKeyword

### Email/queryChanges (RFC 8621 §5.4)
- Returns removed + added items since sinceState

### Email/set (RFC 8621 §5.5)
- create: assign threadId (new or existing based on References/In-Reply-To headers), mailboxIds, keywords
- update: patch mailboxIds, keywords — do NOT allow modifying immutable fields (from, subject, body → immutableError)
- destroy: remove from all mailboxes; if last email in thread, destroy thread too

## Key design decisions
- Thread assignment: handler logic, not backend — inspect headers to find matching thread
- Immutable fields (RFC 8621 §5.5): receivedAt, size, blobId, threadId, messageId, inReplyTo, references, sender, replyTo, from, to, cc, bcc, subject, sentAt, bodyStructure, bodyValues, textBody, htmlBody, attachments, hasAttachment, preview, headers
- keywords use RFC 5788 keyword names: \Seen, \Answered, \Flagged, \Draft, \Deleted
